properties.short_description: TED Talks is a nonprofit platform sharing educational and inspiring ideas worldwide through influential talks and presentations.
Airbnb is a global online marketplace for vacation rentals and unique travel experiences, offering homes, cabins, beach houses, and more worldwide.
VICE is a global media brand known for original journalism and content covering diverse cultural, social, and political topics, including its Spanish-language platform VICE en Español.
Forbes is a global media company known for business news, financial information, and influential lists like Forbes 30 Under 30.
The Economist is a global weekly publication known for independent journalism covering international news, politics, economics, and business.
Wired is a magazine and online publication focusing on technology, digital culture, and innovation.
Business Insider is a global business news website known for its in-depth coverage of finance, tech, and industry trends.
The Wall Street Journal is a leading global news organization known for business, financial, and political news coverage.
The Verge is a technology news and media brand providing news, reviews, and insights on technology, gadgets, and culture.
The New York Times is a leading American newspaper known for its comprehensive news coverage and influential opinion section.
Getty Images is a global visual content creator and marketplace offering a vast collection of high-quality photos, videos, and editorial images, including sports content.
Nike Training Club is a fitness app by Nike offering guided workouts, training plans, and expert advice to help users improve their fitness and training.
Burberry is a British luxury fashion house known for its clothing, bags, accessories, and fragrances.
WeWork provides flexible office spaces, coworking memberships, and turnkey workspace solutions for teams of all sizes globally.
BuzzFeed is an American internet media company known for news, entertainment, quizzes, and viral content across various lifestyle and pop culture topics.
Calm is the #1 app for meditation, sleep, and relaxation, offering science-backed content to reduce stress and improve mental health.
Tinder is the world's most popular dating app, enabling people to meet new friends and romantic partners through swiping.
MasterClass is an online streaming platform offering unlimited access to video lessons taught by world-renowned experts across various fields like writing, business, arts, and more.
Foursquare is a leading geospatial platform offering location technology solutions, a check-in app Swarm, and business listing services.
Omaze is a for-profit entertainment company that offers sweepstakes and prize draws to win luxury experiences and prizes while supporting charitable causes.
